title: Oncomine Focus Assay - Part 1: Target Amplification
author: Opentrons
materials: This is the first part in a multi-part protocol designed to automate the Oncomine Focus Assay. For a detailed description of the manual protocol, please see [this resource.](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2022-01-27/kk23ns4/MAN0015819_Part1_OFAv1S5FTLibraryPrep_UG.pdf) In this protocol, the OT-2 automates the 'Target Amplification' portion of the protocol. Using the complex parameters described below, the user can specify which, if any, modules they are using and select from different options pertaining to RNA/cDNA and DNA. Explanation of complex parameters below: * **Number of Samples**: Specify the number of samples. * **Master Mix Transfer Volume**: Select the volume of mastermix to transfer to the samples. 10µL is for cDNA synthesis and the other options are for DNA. * **Module for Destination Plate**: Select which module you are using for the destination plate (containing samples). If you are not using the [Opentrons Thermocycler Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/thermocycler-module), you will be prompted to remove the plate after liquid handling to an off-deck thermal cycler. * **Number of Cycles**: If using the [Opentrons Thermocycler Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/hardware-modules/products/thermocycler-module), you can specify the number of cycles. For more information, please see [the manual](https://s3.amazonaws.com/pf-upload-01/u-4256/0/2022-01-27/kk23ns4/MAN0015819_Part1_OFAv1S5FTLibraryPrep_UG.pdf). * **Module for Reagent Plate**: Select which module you will use for the plate containing mastermix. * **P20-Multi Mount**: Select which mount the [P20 Multi-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/8-channel-electronic-pipette/) is attached to. ---
If using the Thermocycler Module, the thermal cycling steps will be performed on the OT-2. If not, the user will be prompted to move their plate to an off-deck thermal cycler.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set all required parameters before running the protocol: specify the number of samples; choose the Master Mix Transfer Volume (e.g., 10 µL for cDNA synthesis or other volumes for DNA); select the module for the destination plate (Thermocycler Module or off‑deck thermal cycler); if using the Thermocycler Module, enter the desired number of PCR cycles; select the module for the reagent plate; and indicate the mount for the P20 Multi‑Channel Pipette.

substeps.instruction: Enter the number of samples to be processed.
Choose the Master Mix Transfer Volume (10 µL for cDNA synthesis; other options for DNA).
Select the Destination Plate module (Thermocycler Module or none).
If a Thermocycler Module is selected, input the number of PCR cycles.
Specify the P20‑Multi mount (left or right).

steps.title: Transfer master mix to samples
steps.instruction: For each column of samples, use the P20 Multi‑Channel Pipette to dispense the configured master‑mix volume from column 1 of the reagent plate into the destination plate, mix five times, and discard the tips.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new set of P20‑Multi tips.
Aspirate the specified master‑mix volume from column 1 of the reagent plate.
Dispense the volume into the corresponding column of the destination plate.
Mix the sample by aspirating and dispensing five times.
Eject the used tips to waste.

steps.title: Select thermal cycling platform
steps.instruction: Determine where the PCR will be run: if a Thermocycler Module is attached, the OT‑2 will execute the thermal‑cycling program; otherwise, the protocol will pause and prompt the user to move the plate to an off‑deck thermal cycler.

substeps.instruction: If using the Thermocycler Module, run the programmed cycling steps on‑board.
If not using the module, remove the plate after liquid handling and place it in an external thermal cycler.
